candidates.description: This vector represents common adjectives and descriptive modifiers in Romance languages.
This feature activates on terms related to usage, utilization, and users, primarily in Spanish and English contexts.
This vector activates on Spanish demonstrative pronouns, demonstrative determiners, and general manner adverbs.
This vector represents geographic, spatial, and environmental scale or setting descriptors.
This vector represents common Spanish verbs and related grammatical morphemes.
This vector activates for words and subwords related to geographic locations, nationalities, and American or Hispanic proper nouns.
This vector represents Spanish suffix tokens or morphological word endings.
This feature vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, primarily in Romance languages, along with related intensifying adverbs.
This vector represents Spanish indefinite determiners, pronouns, and related grammatical morphemes.

This feature vector activates on tokens related to words ending in or containing variations of the root "flush," "trim," or phonetically and orthographically similar subword fragments across multiple languages.
